candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: Consumer can install a maximum capacity of rooftop solar net feed-in plant upto 100% of his sanctioned/contracted demand.
415 V at the option of the consumer. For load exceeding 4 kW upto 112 KW , the voltage level is 415V, three phase.
